description: INSERT OR REPLACE with no explicit column list cannot be translated -- PostgreSQL's ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE needs to know which columns to overwrite, and this parser has no way to look up the target table's full column list to guess at one -- Rewrite must reject this rather than guessing

body: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO tF{{DLID}} VALUES (1, 'x')

tests.name: error message explains the dialect translation failure
